passages.title: Noun Groups: Describing Animals and Products
passages.text: At the nature corner, students observed a small brown bird with a curved beak. Its short wings helped it move quickly between nearby trees. Beside the bird’s picture, a large wooden board showed simple facts about its food and habitat. The class also displayed two reusable blue containers for collecting paper. Students noticed that descriptive word groups helped visitors identify objects without reading a very long explanation.
